ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle centered at W, with chord RS on the left, labeled beside it as 5x - 9; on the right there is chord TV, labeled beside it as 2x + 3. Arc RS and arc TV each have a pink tick mark, and the problem also gives \widehat{RS} \cong \widehat{TV}, indicating that these two arcs are congruent. Reasoning: In the same circle, chords subtended by equal arcs are equal, so chord RS = chord TV. Therefore 5x - 9 = 2x + 3. Solving gives 3x = 12, x = 4. Substituting into RS = 5x - 9 gives RS = 5(4) - 9 = 20 - 9 = 11.
